candidates.reason: New FAA recovery posture after Friday ground stop.
New court order has immediate public-access and project-schedule consequence.
Current local cold response with actionable official locator.
Uncovered current survey supports workflow comparison, not fresh credit.

New model/access change with provider claims clearly separated from testing.

stories.new_fact: FAA said air travel should normalize Sunday after the national ground stop.
stories.new_takeaway: Recovery requires checking operational repositioning, not trusting a static schedule.
stories.why_now: The recovery announcement and stated technology/legacy-system interaction followed Friday's interruption.
stories.previous_coverage: Not in the seven compared scripts.
stories.uncertainty: No independently detailed technical root-cause or durable repair was published in the cited reporting.
stories.watch: FAA technical explanation, Sunday cancellations, and repeat outages.

stories.new_fact: A judge ordered a two-week delay on work and closure at East Potomac Golf Course and park.
stories.new_takeaway: An announced public-asset redevelopment can still stop at the legal implementation boundary.
stories.why_now: The order was issued Saturday and preserves existing daily access while the dispute proceeds.
stories.previous_coverage: Not in the seven compared scripts.
stories.uncertainty: The merits and ultimate redevelopment schedule remain unresolved.
stories.watch: Written opinion, negotiated access plan, or further court order.

stories.new_fact: Local reporting highlighted warming-center availability as temperatures fell and the city maintains current access details.
stories.new_takeaway: Eligibility, hours, and confirmation matter more than a generic list of sites.
stories.why_now: Saturday reporting made the cold-weather access response timely.
stories.previous_coverage: Not in the seven compared scripts.
stories.uncertainty: Hours, capacity, and opening conditions can change.
stories.watch: Official locator updates, expanded hours, and sustained cold.

stories.date_exception: Quiet-weekend specialist implementation update; the November 12 survey is explicitly dated and supports a current quote-comparison decision but is not freshness credit.
stories.new_fact: Freddie Mac reported a 7.11% average 30-year fixed rate and 6.45% 15-year average on November 12.
stories.new_takeaway: A weekly average should trigger disciplined like-for-like quote comparison, not a borrower-specific rate inference.
stories.why_now: It is the latest survey and was not used as the prior episode's lending lead.
stories.previous_coverage: November 13 used the 7.11% survey in markets context; this segment uses a different workflow takeaway and labels it dated evidence.
stories.uncertainty: Survey averages do not reveal a particular lender's live price, points, fees, or qualification outcome.
stories.watch: Next survey, live pricing, applications, and pending sales.

stories.date_exception: Quiet-weekend bank-AI implementation evidence; the November 10 research update is newly added to the ledger and does not count toward freshness.
stories.new_fact: A research paper ran four open-weight models through five harnesses on 156 pre-registered simulated retail-bank conduct cases.
stories.new_takeaway: Validation must version-test the full agent harness, not approve a base model once and assume the result transfers.
stories.why_now: The paper supplies an implementation-specific evidence row absent from recent episodes and addresses a different lane than recent bank stories.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent episodes covered BCG control maturity, Bankwest chat handoff, OCC supervision, and Northern Trust onboarding; none covered harness-sensitive simulated conduct testing.
stories.uncertainty: It is simulation research, not a named bank deployment or production outcome.
stories.watch: Named bank controlled evaluations with before-and-after error evidence.
stories.ledger_row_changed: Research-paper / harness-sensitive retail-bank conduct testing — new lane-eight implementation-evidence row; no named production institution or live metric.
stories.metric: 156 pre-registered cases across four models and five harnesses; no human, live-bank, or customer-outcome baseline.

stories.new_fact: Google announced Gemini 4 Hydrogen as a fast model option for Gemini app, Search, AI Mode, and developer surfaces.
stories.new_takeaway: A speed-oriented model change deserves workflow testing on quality, tool errors, corrections, latency, and cost rather than a token-speed conclusion.
stories.why_now: The release was announced November 13 and was not covered in the prior seven scripts.
stories.previous_coverage: No Gemini 4 Hydrogen coverage in the previous seven episodes.
stories.uncertainty: Reported instruction-following, hallucination, and speed gains are provider claims absent a cited independent reproduction.
stories.watch: Model card, pricing/access detail, and independent task evaluation.
stories.frontier_bar: new capability with measured/provider-reported performance claims; treated as an access/capability change, not independently verified performance.
